findings.text: the new test file has no trailing newline, which ruff reports as W292 (selected through the `W` family in pyproject.toml [tool.ruff.lint]); the commit therefore adds one lint finding to a tree whose declared policy is that a commit adds none

`assert result.exit_code != 2` is inert for the defect under test: the dispose verb refuses an unknown family with `click.ClickException` at reckon/crew_run_commands.py:1220, whose exit code is 1, not 2, so this line never reddens on the rubric refusal and the guard rests entirely on the assertion at line 93

the sub-floor dimension composition site is corrected only through the shared `_cli_review_rubric` normaliser and is not exercised by the new test, which drives the blocking-finding path; a regression that stops routing this site through the normaliser would print a refused rubric with no test reddening

item_verdicts.call_sites: verified the production callers of the changed normaliser in reckon/crew/obligations.py
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit across c9c18387d2, efd8834a67 and e53aa65f3d: one twelve-line behaviour change in the shared normaliser, one 96-line test, and one evidence fragment citing the measured arms.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_dispose_hint_is_accepted_as_printed.py; the reviewed run's manifest records the scoped gate at 60 passed / EXIT=0 and the base arm at 1 failed / 1 passed / EXIT=1, and both logs sit under the run directory carrying revision, literal command and a closing EXIT= line.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is that every dispose command an obligation prints is accepted by the command as printed; reckon/crew/obligations.py:1131 now emits the rubric flag only for the figure family, which is the only one reckon/crew_run_commands.py:1220 accepts.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, gate and suite logs, the negative control, and one rubric line per dimension, and its claimed arm summaries match the logs at scoped-gate-1795352431468419284.log:8 (60 passed) and baseline_suite-1795352562286796798.log:8 (58 passed).
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's four declared paths; the diff's three paths (obligations.py, the new test, the evidence fragment) are all inside them, and the declared figure directory is simply unused.

justifications.durability: the assertion at tests/test_a_dispose_hint_is_accepted_as_printed.py:93 fails if obligations.py:1131 regresses to returning the stored family, as the base arm in negative-control-base.log demonstrates; the dimension-branch site and the inert line-94 assertion are recorded as findings.
justifications.evidence: the done_when's own file ran as the scoped gate at efd8834a673d for 60 passed / EXIT=0 and the base arm at a2bf0d8d5a65 fails the code-review case with the exact refusal, all recorded in the reviewed run's logs; the after-suite arm ran at efd8834a673d rather than the docs-only head e53aa65f.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/obligations.py:1131 keeps the module's docstring-and-normaliser idiom and reuses review_module.FIGURE_REVIEW_RUBRIC rather than a string literal, but the new test file adds a W292 finding that pyproject.toml [tool.ruff.lint] selects.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/obligations.py:1131 now returns the rubric only for review_module.FIGURE_REVIEW_RUBRIC and None otherwise, so every hint composed from a health, run, code or node record renders without a flag the verb refuses.
justifications.reuse: the change extends the existing owner, reckon/crew/obligations.py:_cli_review_rubric, in place and renders through review_dispositions.dispose_commands; a capability search over obligations.py, review_dispositions.py and recovery_review_dispatch.py found no second rubric-flag normaliser (_review_dispatch_field selects a pointer field, not a flag).
justifications.scope_discipline: all three diff paths (reckon/crew/obligations.py, tests/test_a_dispose_hint_is_accepted_as_printed.py, docs/evidence/fragments/delivered-work-lands-without-a-coordinator/dwlw-a-dispose-hint-is-accepted-as-printed.html) lie inside the four declared write paths, and the change carries nothing the goal does not imply.
